To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the foliar application of Ax+CK+ GA, isolated or in combined with Ma+Mi promoted the precocity and productivity of tomato fruits.
the foliar application of growth regulators and mineral nutrition improved tomato fruit quality.
the foliar application of Ax+CK+Ga isolated or in combination promoted the precocity and productivity of tomato plants, and the use Ax+CK+GAmi and Mi increased the ascorbate content in fruits.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the application of plant regulators and micronutrients to increase the productivity of the tomato plant and the post-harvest quality of the fruit.
improving the productivity, precocity and quality of tomatoes by applying foliar products, based on growth regulators, macro or micronutrients, or in combination.

the nutritional and productive performance of tomato plants, and the application of plant hormones and mineral elements, which may improve the nutritional value of tomato fruits and their shelf life, contributing to the improvement of the quality of this product, which is widely used in human nutrition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of the foliar application of plant growth regulator and macro and micronutrient mixtures, alone and combined, increased the productivity and quality of tomato fruits.

the application of growth regulators and macro and micronutrient mixtures increased the tomato productivity, improved the precocity and the ascorbic content of the fruits, and the use in combination of growth regulators and mineral nutrient mixtures promoted the increase of soluble solids content, pH, and the ratio soluble solids/acid.
the use of the growth regulator Ax+CK+Ga, isolated or in conjunction with the macro and micronutrient mixture, increased the tomato plant productivity and fruit quality.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the application of plant regulators, macro and micro nutrients, isolated and in combination increased the production, precocity and quality of tomato fruits.

the foliar application of growth regulators (Ax+CK + GA), micronutrients (Mi) and macro and micronutrient mixtures (Ma + Mi), isolated or in combination improved the productivity and quality of tomato fruits.

the application of growth regulators, macro or micronutrients, alone or in combination, improves the nutritional and post harvest quality of tomatoes, and the application of growth regulator Ax+CK+ GA (Ma+Mi), Ax+CK+Ga Mi (Ma+ Mi) and Mi, isolated or combined, increased the production and precocity of the tomato plants.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the application of Ax+CK+ GA, isolated or combined with Ma+Mi or Mi, improves tomato plant precocity and productivity.
the use of growth regulators and macro and micronutrient fertilization, isolated and combined, improved the nutritional quality of tomato fruits.
the application of growth regulators, isolated or in combined with macro and micronutrient, increases the tomato productivity and the ascorbic content in the fruits.
